host.description: Modbus TCP server hostname or IP address

port.description: TCP port number (standard Modbus port is 502)

unitId.description: Modbus unit/slave ID (0 = broadcast, 1-247 = specific device)

readTimeoutMs.description: Read operation response timeout in milliseconds

writeTimeoutMs.description: Write operation response timeout in milliseconds

maxRegistersPerRead.description: Maximum number of registers per read request (Modbus limit is 125)

connectionSummary: Standard Modbus TCP client workflow for PLC and RTU devices.
connectionSteps: Set the target device IP address and TCP port. The common default port is 502.
If the device exposes a unit address, fill in the Unit ID before connecting.
After the session is connected, read and write registers with function codes such as FC01-FC04 for reads and FC05/FC06/FC15/FC16 for writes.
readBehavior: Read operations send a Modbus request frame and return the payload bytes from the device response. Supports coils (FC01), discrete inputs (FC02), holding registers (FC03), and input registers (FC04).
